name: Liquid melt: text melts into drips that pool on the floor
description: A word (or any layer) melts: liquid drips of different lengths run down from the bottom of every letter in the letter's colour, then bend and spread along a floor line. Readable throughout (drips only fall from the lowest ink). The glow option gives neon drips.
source: r05 S3 f110-210 'ideas' melts into rainbow neon drips that run down and flow across the floor (measured melt ease 0.376, 0.12, 0.234, 0.97)

layerId.description: The text / shape / image layer to melt (text is nested in a precomp first, it stays editable).

length.description: Drip length px (default: the comp height).

floorY.description: Floor line, comp px (default 97 % of the height).

spacing.description: Px between separate drips, about one stroke width.

sway.description: Sideways wobble px (4-10 keeps the drips parallel).

variance.description: How much drip lengths differ; near 1 = separate drips with gaps.

glow.description: Neon glow on the melting layer.
